mapper.sql: SELECT n.id, n.book_name AS bookName, n.cover_url AS picUrl, n.original_file_name AS originalFileName, n.encoding, n.file_size AS fileSize, n.word_count AS wordCount, n.chapter_count AS chapterCount, n.first_chapter_id AS firstChapterId, p.chapter_id AS lastReadChapterId, pc.chapter_name AS lastReadChapterName, p.read_at AS lastReadAt, n.create_time AS createTime, n.update_time AS updateTime, COALESCE(s.visibility, 'PRIVATE') AS visibility, s.author_name AS authorName, s.category_id AS categoryId, s.book_desc AS bookDesc, s.rights_confirmed AS rightsConfirmed, s.id AS submissionId, s.status AS submissionStatus, s.rejection_reason AS rejectionReason, s.public_book_id AS publicBookId, s.public_status AS publicStatus FROM user_novel n LEFT JOIN user_novel_progress p ON p.novel_id = n.id AND p.user_id = n.user_id LEFT JOIN user_novel_chapter pc ON pc.id = p.chapter_id AND pc.novel_id = n.id LEFT JOIN novel_submission s ON s.user_novel_id = n.id AND s.user_id = n.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_novel (user_id, book_name, cover_url, original_file_name, encoding, file_size, word_count, chapter_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookName}, #{coverUrl}, #{originalFileName}, #{encoding}, #{fileSize}, #{wordCount}, #{chapterCount})

INSERT INTO user_novel_chapter (novel_id, chapter_num, chapter_name, content, word_count) VALUES
(#{c.novelId}, #{c.chapterNum}, #{c.chapterName}, #{c.content}, #{c.wordCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_novel SET first_chapter_id = #{chapterId} WHERE id = #{novelId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_novel WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.novel_id AS bookId, c.chapter_num AS chapterNum, c.chapter_name AS chapterName, c.word_count AS wordCount, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime FROM user_novel_chapter c JOIN user_novel n ON n.id = c.novel_id AND n.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.novel_id AS novelId, c.chapter_num AS chapterNum, c.chapter_name AS chapterName, c.content, c.word_count AS wordCount, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime FROM user_novel_chapter c JOIN user_novel n ON n.id = c.novel_id AND n.user_id = #{userId} WHERE c.novel_id = #{novelId} AND c.id = #{chapterId} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_novel WHERE id = #{novelId} AND user_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM user_novel_progress WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND user_id = #{userId}
DELETE c FROM user_novel_chapter c JOIN user_novel n ON n.id = c.novel_id WHERE n.id = #{novelId} AND n.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_novel SET cover_url = #{coverUrl} WHERE id = #{novelId} AND user_id = #{userId}
